originality.rationale: The September 2026 primary introduction develops coproduct-coprime ideals and a full prime/coprime homeomorphism in dual rings, with a single non-dual square-zero counterexample to coprimality. The new theorem classifies EVERY Artinian ring and shows that its coprime spectrum is the Gorenstein component locus even when some factors are non-dual. The non-Gorenstein local emptiness argument is not supplied by the dual-ring theorem. Targeted equivalence/parameter/implication searches and existing mathematical records found no matching classification; unindexed prior coverage and inaccessible parts of the most relevant paper remain residual risks.

value.rationale: The new ideal coproduct spectrum, unlike Spec, can be empty even on a nonzero local Artinian ring. A complete structural classification on all commutative Artinian rings shows precisely that it detects only Gorenstein local components, including mixed factors that the published dual-ring theorem cannot address. This is a natural full class and topological invariant, not an arbitrary finite parameter or mere numerical recomputation; the explicit Nakayama witness rules out any overlooked coprime ideals in non-Gorenstein local factors. Value is specific to finite-length ring structure, not asserted for general rings.
